Maya (partnerships): heads-up: Datadog asked for a short OTLP/metrics smoke on our private GPU appliance before we publish the marketplace tile. They want traces, cache metrics, and alert rules exercised. Can we carve out a 45m slot next Weds?
Rohan (eng-runtime): yes, but need their sample workload container, OTLP endpoint, and a scoped ingest key. Also confirm sampling policy and whether they want exporter heap snapshots.
Noah (datadog-alliances): we9ll provide trimmed dashboard JSON + alert queries. Use an ingest-only key. No heap profile from partner side; we9d like exporter RSS and queue depth. Sampling: 1/10 normal, 1/1 on error.
Ella (eng-ml): to hit eviction counters run mixed seq lengths [64,256,1024] and some 2-3 long-running spans. Partner hosts the model binary.
Maya (partnerships): partner will drop compose + runbook. They asked for staging verification to avoid broken charts on the tile.
Rohan (eng-runtime): plan: 1) quick staging smoke (20m) 2) tweak exporter flags (batch_size, linger_ms, max_queue) 3) run on SI rack 4) capture dashboard snapshot + perf slice. Who owns pub snapshot?
Jin (product): partnerships owns press snapshot and quote; eng supplies perf numbers and 2-line blurb for tile. Legal needs 24h review after run.
Rohan (eng-runtime): quick curl to sanity-check exporter in staging when up:
```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST http://localhost:4318/v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/x-protobuf' --data-binary @tiny_trace.pbf
# expect 200
```
deploy-bot: deploy redwood/embedded-exporter:v1.5.1 to staging succeeded (logs: /deploys/3461112222)
Maya (partnerships): actions: Noah to drop dashboard + collector config EOD; Rohan/Ella to run staging smoke Thurs AM; partner run Weds next week. I9ll loop in legal and comms. :rocket:
Jin (product): add single-line success criteria: "Tiles show trace ingest <500ms median, cache eviction visible, exporter mem growth <15% over 30m."
Rohan (eng-runtime): added to checklist. Will post staging snapshot and logs in this thread after run.
Noah (datadog-alliances): will send demo creds with embargo and a short wiring snippet for the tile docs. :lock:
